extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: travel trailer (caravan with tandem axle), approx. 6.0 x 2.2 x 2.6 m (L x W x H incl. drawbar and roof dome), wheel diameter 0.66 m
extras.notes: front (drawbar) faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow body with transparent windows, dinette with table, kitchen block and bed inside; entry door is part of the body; ball coupling, jockey wheel and gas locker on the A-frame drawbar; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
